Define a new Op

Source: R/op.R
new_Op.Rd

Creates the descriptor of a StableHLO operation, consumed by hlo_fn().

Usage

new_Op(classname, mnemonic, dialect = "stablehlo", render = NULL)

Arguments

classname

Name of the op (kept for readability at the call sites).

mnemonic

The operation mnemonic.

dialect

The MLIR dialect ("stablehlo" or "chlo"). Defaults to "stablehlo".

render

(function(ctx) | NULL)
Custom render function producing the op's MLIR line. NULL uses the default assembly/generic format. The ctx argument is a list with fields mnemonic, dialect, outputs_str, values_str, in_type_strs, out_type_strs, sig_str, attrs, attrs_str, funcs_str and custom_attrs.

Value

A descriptor list for use with hlo_fn().
